issues.description: The task (Aufgabe 01) asks for ID, Name, Art and URL of all Freibäder, but the provided solution query only selects name, art and url and omits the ID. The template starts with SELECT * (which would include the ID), so the solution and the problem statement disagree about the required columns; this can confuse students about whether the ID must be returned and which column name to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure the solution explicitly returns the ID column as requested by the problem. For example, update the query to explicitly select the ID along with name, art and url (and use the actual column name from the schema), e.g.: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad'. Also align the template/example comments to show the intended explicit columns rather than SELECT * to avoid ambiguity.
